panel_description: log-log scatter of wet mass vs dry mass across planarian body sizes with a linear power-law fit; the paper annotates the isometric scaling exponent 1.03 +/- 0.01.
transformations: From Figure 1-source data 1 (Wet mass mg, Dry mass mg); drop the trailing balance-readability note row; take log10 of each mass. x=log10 dry mass, y=log10 wet mass.
known_missing_information: Paper uses log-scaled axes (decade ticks) rather than plotted log10 values; the app default OLS fit over all 28 points gives exponent 1.14 vs the paper's 1.03 for the isometric regime (dry >= 0.15 mg reproduces 1.03).
